subject: pipeline cache c6i: persistence evidence + shared cache dir
body: c6ic boot2 log is the SAME boot (first 632552 bytes identical, one exec backboardd/SpringBoard) so it says nothing about persistence. Pre-c6i snapshot (HFS catalog read) shows /private/var/tmp/com.tegu.metal.pipelines owned by mobile(501) with 273 entries incl. 79 with the c6hc build tag: writes happen and persist across boots/flash. Mobile Caches dir com.tegu.metal.pipelines is root:mobile 0700 (115 root 0600 leftovers from the probe) so mobile (backboardd/SpringBoard LaunchDaemons UserName=mobile) cannot use it -> fallback to /var/tmp. Changes: frontend tries /private/var/mobile/Library/Caches first, logs TEGU_PIPELINE_CACHE_DIRS (errno of mkdir/open/write per candidate) and TEGU_PERF_DISK (reads/absent/rejects/writes/write_fail/errno); entries/dir created 0644/0755; installer guest script (shared by update_metal_offline_fast.py) chowns the dir 501:501 0755 and drops root leftovers; catalog allowlists updated. Host tests pass incl. run_host_tests.sh (last step needs NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN; ran build_metal_probe.sh --binary-only instead).
